reviews.text: We sent our Australian Shepard to Active K9 to work on her reactivity towards both dogs and children. She was there for about 8 weeks and has since shown an astounding amount of progress with her reactivity. We still work with Active K9 on our Aussie's upkeep and could not be more happy or grateful! They are amazing trainers that our family would recommend to anyone! Plus, our dog seemed to really enjoy her time there, which is always a nice bonus!

Missy has done so many amazing changes for my dog and I. Just when I was starting to give up hope we found Missy and she completely changed by dog for the better and gave her so much more confidence which allowed her to act like a dog and go for walks and feel ok with new surroundings when normally she would never be ok with that. Thank you so much for her amazing bond with dogs and allowing my dog zina and I to form a better bond and helped her feel more confident about herself. I would 100% recommend her if you need some guidance and help with your dog!
